title: Market Research identities (mr.identities/1)
description: Share, winrate and top-cut conversion per identity in the slice's current period.

schema.description: Schema ID and major version of this file.

version.description: Snapshot version this file belongs to: the UTC start time of the pipeline run that published it, as YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same as the v=<version>/ folder the file is in and the manifest's version.

side.description: Side this slice covers: corp or runner.

restriction.description: Ban list of this slice: a NetrunnerDB Standard restriction ID (e.g. standard_ban_list_26_05), or all for every ban list combined.

tier_group.description: Tier group of this slice (an id from the manifest's tier_groups, e.g. gnk, store, megacity, online), or all for every tier combined.

period.description: Current period, the same as summary.json's (always the default period). Null when the slice has no decks.

from.description: First month of the period (YYYY-MM, inclusive).

to.description: Last month of the period (YYYY-MM, inclusive).

baseline.description: Totals for the whole side in the current period, which the identity metrics are compared with.

entries.description: Entries on this side with a known identity. The denominator of share.

games.description: Every reported game of those entries on this side, excluding intentional draws.

wins.description: Wins in those games; a draw counts as half a win.

cut_entries.description: Entries in tournaments with a top cut in which identities are known for at least thresholds.coverage_hc of the entries. The denominator of the side's cut rate.

cut_made.description: Of those entries, the ones that made the top cut.

cut_rate.description: cut_made / cut_entries (0-1): the side's average top-cut rate. Null without entries.

identities.description: Every identity played in the current period, most played first.

card_id.description: Card ID of the identity (from the catalog).

rank.description: Position by entries (1 = most played; ties by card_id).

games.description: Every reported game of those entries, excluding intentional draws.

wins.description: Wins in those games; a draw counts as half a win.

winrate_diff_pp.description: winrate - baseline.winrate, in percentage points. Null when either is null.

wilson_low_pp.description: Lower bound of the Wilson 95% interval of winrate, minus baseline.winrate, in percentage points. Null without games or without a baseline winrate.

wilson_high_pp.description: Upper bound of the Wilson 95% interval of winrate, minus baseline.winrate, in percentage points. Null without games or without a baseline winrate.

winrate_status.description: ok when games is at least thresholds.min_games (manifest), otherwise insufficient: too small a sample for the winrate to be meaningful.

cut_entries.description: Entries on this identity in tournaments with a top cut in which identities are known for at least thresholds.coverage_hc of the entries.

cut_made.description: Of those entries, the ones that made the top cut.

conversion_ratio.description: conversion / baseline.cut_rate: 1 = the side's average. Null when either is null or zero.

conversion_status.description: ok when cut_entries is at least thresholds.min_entries (manifest), otherwise insufficient: too small a sample for the conversion to be meaningful.
